title: Truncated Plethystic Exponentials Preserve Power Sum Constraints
summary: Given an arbitrary sequence $(α_1, \ldots, α_n) \in \mathbb{C}^n$, we show that the degree-$n$ truncation of the formal exponential $\exp\bigl(-\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{α_k}{k} x^k\bigr)$ produces a polynomial whose roots $ρ_1, \ldots, ρ_n$ satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^n ρ_i^{-k} = α_k$ exactly for $k = 1, \ldots, n$. This truncation-exactness property is an algebraic identity in the ring of formal power series, proved by coefficient matching.
